grammar.summary: 本课学习比较级与最高级。

points.title: 比较级/最高级规则
points.explanation: 短词 + er/est（clean→cleaner→cleanest）；长词 more/most（more beautiful, the most beautiful）；最高级前必须加 the。比较对象用 than 连接。

examples.en: My garden is the most beautiful in the town.
examples.cn: 我的花园是镇上最美的。

examples.en: Joe's garden is more interesting than Bill's.
examples.cn: Joe 的花园比 Bill 的有趣。

points.title: every year 时间状语与频率
points.explanation: every year / nearly 表频率的副词位置：nearly every year 放时间词前。

examples.en: I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
examples.cn: 我总是获得镇上最差花园的小奖！

exercises.q: Which is the longest river ___ the world?
This is the finest picture ___ them all.
This stereo is the most expensive ___ all the ones in the shop.
He is the best boxer ___ our town.
